title: Plugins and modules
description: Review installed built-in modules and enable or disable optional display extensions. Only server-side allowlisted modules are accepted; uploaded code is never executed.
help.toggleable: Only display extensions that can be safely switched are managed here. Changes apply to subsequent public page requests.
help.inventory: Payments, translation, CDN, OAuth, rich text and multilingual content have dedicated settings. This inventory reports their actual state and links to those pages.
help.security: The system does not provide arbitrary plugin upload, script execution, web SQL or installation from external code sources. New capabilities must be added through a reviewed release.
detail.support_widget: Show or hide the public feedback and Enterprise WeChat support widget.
detail.announcement_menu: Show or hide the announcement popover in the navigation. Announcement content remains managed by the announcement module.
kind.toggleable: A display module that can be safely enabled or disabled.
kind.locked: This module is governed by its dedicated configuration and cannot bypass those checks from this page.
message.error.session: Your session or request origin is no longer valid. Sign in again.
message.error.invalid: The module settings are invalid. Refresh and try again.
message.error.service: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
message.error.generic: The operation did not complete. Check the values or sign in again.
